frictions.resolution: Documented as expected failure - NULL current->mem crash during early boot is a known issue

blockers.description: Guest runtime execution fails due to NULL current->mem crash during early boot sequence. This prevents reaching login_ready milestone and displaying functional shell.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: This is a known architectural issue documented in user-testing.md. The crash occurs because do_execve() modifies current->mm and current->mem but these changes may not be visible to emulator threads before task_start(). Memory barrier (__sync_synchronize) was added but issue persists.

summary: Tested 4 assertions: 2 passed, 2 failed. App builds and launches successfully (FULL-RUNTIME-001: PASS). App remains stable for 30 seconds (FULL-RUNTIME-004: PASS). However, guest runtime fails to initialize - shell prompt does not appear (FULL-RUNTIME-002: FAIL) and terminal is not interactive (FULL-RUNTIME-003: FAIL). This is a known issue where the NULL current->mem crash during early boot prevents reaching login_ready milestone. The ISH_TASK_ZERO_FULL_RUNTIME flag is correctly set to 1 and task_start() is being called, but the guest execution encounters a runtime error.
